No price option can be put forward yet, because the model could not test your under‑4% monthly churn requirement.

- The comparison itself held up under the changes tested, but that is not a check that any option meets both of your stated conditions.
- The result is particularly dependent on the feature-release value assumption—an Olumi estimate, not recorded evidence—and on active subscribers, new subscribers and churn, which are also modelled rather than observed inputs.
- The £20k MRR target was not scored either: its threshold frame and the goal’s direction were unspecified in the analysis.

A useful next reasoning step is to define how the model should measure the churn limit and MRR target against the analysis outputs.
